text:
tom.prodeng: Quick announcement — were rolling out two billing updates next month: a temporary overage grace window and a new "streaming-minute" invoice line for streaming-heavy workloads. Posting here for visibility and ops/readiness checks.

billing-bot: [Draft saved] https://redwood.internal/drafts/streaming-billing-2026 (preview link)

rachel.billing: TL;DR: 1) Overage grace window: for hosted accounts we'll delay applying overage charges for 72 hours after quota exceedance to give customers a chance to upgrade or throttle. 2) Streaming endpoints (chat-stream) will also be billable by minute in addition to token billing; invoice line_type will be `stream_minutes`.

cfo.sara: Why by-minute? We saw some customers with lots of low-token long-lived streams where token-only billing underestimated backend costs. Minute billing lets us capture connection/compute time more fairly. Not a price increase overall; it's a rebalancing of metering.

engops.max: Ops notes: grace window applies only to hosted metered accounts (not dedicated). After 72h, unpaid overages will be invoiced and may trigger limited throttling until payment/commit. Well emit audit events when grace starts/ends.

support.kate: Support prep: suggested reply to customers who hit the grace window: "We temporarily hold overage charges for 72 hours so you can assess usage and choose a plan. If you expect sustained usage, upgrading prevents interruption."

rachel.billing: Invoice schema change: CSVs will now include possible `stream_minutes` rows. Example snippet: 
```
schema_version=4
invoice_id,line_type,usage_units,unit_price,amount,region_code
inv_20260701,stream_minutes,45,0.0200,0.90,eu-central
inv_20260701,tokens,12000,0.0006,7.20,eu-central
```

tom.prodeng: Rollout plan: internal notice today, public help doc + blog 2026-06-10, grace window enabled for all hosted accounts 2026-06-15, invoice schema migration 2026-06-20 02:00-02:30 UTC (CSV exports may include schema_version=4).

engops.max: Rate-limit change for streaming: default soft-rate for streaming connections will be 200 concurrent streams per org, with recommended burst handling. Premium orgs can request raised limits. This is separate from token rate-limits.

cfo.sara: Finance: we'll track net impact month-over-month. We have a pilot to let some existing users roll unused monthly quota into a small rollover bucket (max 10% of monthly quota) for one month — that pilot will be by invite only.

support.kate: Partner question: do partner-issued trials get the grace window?

rachel.billing: Partners: platform defaults get the grace window but partners can opt in/out per-account. We'll notify partner teams separately.

tom.prodeng: Action items:
- Product: update billing FAQ and plan UX to show grace window and stream-minute metering.
- Eng: add `stream_minutes` handling to metering pipeline and update CSV exporter to emit schema_version=4.
- Support: update canned responses and the escalation playbook.
- Finance: monitor pilot metrics and report after month 1.

billing-bot: [Automated] Owners assigned: @rachel.billing (billing), @tom.prodeng (product), @engops.max (ops)

tom.prodeng: Please flag any blocking issues before EOD tomorrow. If none, we plan to push the help doc draft live on 2026-06-10. Thanks! :thumbsup:
